The '''drop pod''' was a simple ship designed to transport a ground vehicle to the surface of a planet. It was pressurized and filled with atmosphere, but there were no passenger accommodations. The drop pod was launched from space, and piloted by a droid brain to the designated landing zone. Once landed, the drop ship was blown apart by self-destructive bolt to release the vehicle inside.<ref name="GaW" /> Drop pods were also used to carry [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]]. To keep them intact during crash landings, [[Heat shield/Legends|heat shields]] were often affixed to the pods.<ref name="DS">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
